title: Ruleswright Override Document — schemaVersion 1
description: GM/author patches to individual pack artifacts, merged at load (FR-19). Applied in array order AFTER base-pack load validation and BEFORE final validation of the merged document — an override can never produce a structurally invalid pack. Unknown target id = E-OVR-01. Theme composition (FR-20) uses the same merge model one level up.

target.description: Artifact id — unique across the whole pack by E-DUP-01, so unambiguous

patch.description: Keys are dotted paths into the artifact (e.g. "actions.claw.onHit"); values are replacement scalars/objects, deep-merged per key in array order
